catalog.blurb: Pair your own WhatsApp via QR so the agent can read and reply in your personal chats. Unofficial client — Meta may ban the number; use a secondary number.
catalog.title: WhatsApp (personal)

dataBindings.description: Pairing status for this owner (metadata only, never secrets).
dataBindings.name: pairing_status

description: Agent presence in the user's own WhatsApp chats via a Baileys sidecar + QR pairing. Inbound is default-deny; outbound only through the reviewed action flow (whatsapp.send). Unofficial client: account-ban risk, explicit opt-in required.
name: WhatsApp (personal)

whatsapp_search_recent.description: Search recent inbound WhatsApp messages (stripped metadata only). Read-only.

whatsapp_send.description: Propose a WhatsApp message for owner review. Never sends directly: creates a whatsapp.send reviewed action, and execution additionally requires the recipient to be on the allow-list.
